title: A flaw has been found in Soarkey StudentManagement up to e08f7f1d5015af407aa4cca0ada3dea189b4937e. (CVE-2026-111993)
description: A flaw in Soarkey StudentManagement up to commit e08f7f1d5015af407aa4cca0ada3dea189b4937e affects the UserDao.login function in AdminDao.java. This vulnerability involves manipulation of the Password argument causing cleartext storage of sensitive information. Exploitation requires local access. The issue was reported early to the project, but no response or fix has been issued yet. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 3.3 and no known active exploitation in the wild.
aiSummary: The vulnerability in Soarkey StudentManagement affects the UserDao.login function within the AdminDao.java source file. It allows an attacker with local access to manipulate the Password argument, resulting in the cleartext storage of sensitive information. This flaw compromises confidentiality but does not impact integrity or availability. The project was notified early but has not provided a fix or response. Exploit code has been published, but no known in-the-wild exploitation has been reported.
aiImpact: The vulnerability leads to the cleartext storage of sensitive password information, which could allow an attacker with local access to obtain confidential credentials. The impact is limited to confidentiality loss with no direct effect on integrity or availability. Since exploitation requires local privileges, the risk is lower compared to remote vulnerabilities.
